patch.description: EPIC-17/G04 remains In Progress through V01→V02→V03 and safe merge. Admission: docs/planning/EPIC-17-ADMISSION.md. S660's two bounded read-only Sol high reviews are complete. Next is one falsifiable empirical hypothesis: the hash-pinned generic AC1014 S648 Polo M DXF through DGS AUTOCAD import.
